scenario.title: 好久不見的朋友聚會
scenario.context: 第一章的收尾：一場老朋友的聚會。你會聊到現在在做什麼（現在式）、最近發生什麼（過去式）、接下來的計畫（未來式），前九個單元的句型全部會用上。

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.en: Minz? No way! Long time no see!
lines.zh: Minz？不會吧！好久不見！

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Kevin! Oh my god, it's been, what, three years?
lines.zh: Kevin！天啊，大概有……三年了吧？

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.en: At least. Are you still working at that agency?
lines.zh: 至少有。你還在那間廣告公司嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: No, I left last year. I work for myself now. I'm a freelance illustrator.
lines.zh: 沒有，我去年離職了。現在自己接案，當自由插畫師。

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.en: That's awesome. How's it going?
lines.zh: 太棒了。還順利嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Pretty well, actually. I'm working on a project for a tea brand right now. What about you?
lines.zh: 其實還不錯。我現在在做一個茶飲品牌的案子。你呢？

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.en: I'm still at the bank, but I'm moving to Singapore next month.
lines.zh: 我還在銀行，但下個月要搬去新加坡了。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Next month? We need to catch up before you go!
lines.zh: 下個月？你走之前我們一定要好好聊聊！

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: What if we throw you a little farewell party this Saturday?
lines.zh: 這週六幫你辦個小小的送別派對怎麼樣？

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.en: That would be amazing. Where, though?
lines.zh: 那太好了。不過要在哪裡？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: My place. It's a bit small, but it's a stone's throw from the MRT.
lines.zh: 我家。有點小，但離捷運站超近。

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.en: Perfect. Should I bring anything?
lines.zh: 完美。我需要帶什麼嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: It's BYOB, and I'll order some food.
lines.zh: 酒水自備，我會叫點吃的。

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.en: Got it. I'll bring some wine, then.
lines.zh: 了解，那我帶點紅酒。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Great. I'm going to invite some people from the old office, too.
lines.zh: 好。我也打算邀一些以前辦公室的人。

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.en: Just don't invite Chris. He'll flake anyway.
lines.zh: 別邀 Chris 就好，反正他一定會放鳥。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: How was the party last night?
lines.zh: 昨晚的派對怎麼樣？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: It was a blast! Almost everyone came, and we stayed up till three.
lines.zh: 超好玩！幾乎每個人都有來，我們聊到三點。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Three? You must be wiped out.
lines.zh: 三點？你一定累爆了吧。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Totally. I slept in till noon and I'm still cleaning up.
lines.zh: 完全是。我睡到中午，現在還在收拾。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Did Chris show up?
lines.zh: Chris 有出現嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Surprisingly, yes! He even brought a cake.
lines.zh: 出乎意料，有！他還帶了蛋糕。

patterns.note: 比 long time no see 更強調「太久」

patterns.en: What have you been up to?

patterns.note: 受邀去別人家時的禮貌問句

patterns.en: We should do this more often.

chinglish.wrong: I miss you so much, where did you go these years?
chinglish.right: I've missed you! What have you been up to?
chinglish.why: 「這幾年你去哪了」直翻聽起來像在質問。母語者會用 What have you been up to? 輕鬆問近況。
home party 不是英文常用的說法。直接說 Come on in / Make yourself at home 就很自然。

chinglish.wrong: I will move to Singapore next month.
chinglish.right: I'm moving to Singapore next month.
chinglish.why: 已經確定的搬家行程用現在進行式（複習第 9 單元）。

chinglish.right: The party yesterday was so much fun.
chinglish.why: 已經過去用 was；fun 是名詞，口語常說 so much fun / a lot of fun。

grammar.title: 時態總整理
grammar.oneLiner: 講話前先問自己：這件事是長期的、此刻的、已經結束的，還是還沒發生的？
whenToUse: 現在簡單式：身分、習慣、事實。I work for myself.
現在進行式：此刻、這陣子、已排定的未來。I'm working on a project. / I'm moving next month.
過去簡單式：已經結束的事。I left last year. / Almost everyone came.
be going to：已經打算好的事。I'm going to invite some people.
will：當下決定、提議、一般預測。I'll bring some wine. / He'll flake anyway.
問句和否定句別忘了助動詞：do / does / did 後面接原形。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 這一章的每個文法點，背後都是同一個問題：中文動詞不用變化，時間靠「昨天、正在、要、了」來標示。英文把時間資訊塞進動詞本身，所以每說一句話，腦中都得先確認時間軸。這需要練習，不是理解了就會。多開口，錯了再修正就好。

examples.correct: I left the agency last year, and now I work for myself.
examples.incorrect: I leave the agency last year, and now I am work for myself.
examples.note: 過去的事用過去式；現在的身分用簡單式。

examples.correct: I'm working on a big project this month.
examples.note: 這陣子正在做的事用進行式。

examples.correct: Kevin is moving to Singapore next month.
examples.incorrect: Kevin will move to Singapore next month.
examples.note: 已經確定的行程用進行式比較自然。

examples.correct: A: We need drinks. B: I'll grab some.
Did you have fun last night?
examples.incorrect: Did you had fun last night?

quiz.question: I ___ at an agency for three years, but I quit last year.
quiz.explanation: 已經結束的事用過去式。

quiz.question: Right now I ___ on a logo for a tea shop.
quiz.explanation: 此刻或這陣子正在做的事用進行式。

quiz.question: We ___ (fly) to Tokyo next Friday. The tickets are already booked.
quiz.explanation: 已經訂好的行程用現在進行式。

quiz.question: A: The ice is almost gone. B: No problem, I ___ buy more.
___ you go to Kevin's party last Saturday?

slang.usage: It was a blast! / We had a blast. 比 very fun 強烈又自然。

risk.note: 正面詞，跟同事主管說也沒問題。

examples.en: Thanks for inviting me. I had a blast!
examples.zh: 謝謝邀請，我玩得超開心！

examples.en: The company trip was a blast this year.
examples.zh: 今年的員工旅遊超好玩。

slang.usage: 跟一陣子沒見的人更新彼此近況。We should catch up! / Let's grab coffee and catch up.

risk.note: 工作上也常用：Let's catch up next week（下週來對一下進度）。

examples.en: It's been forever! Let's get dinner and catch up.
examples.zh: 超久不見了！一起吃晚餐聊聊吧。

examples.en: We spent the whole afternoon catching up.
examples.zh: 我們整個下午都在敘舊。

slang.usage: 久別重逢的招呼。有趣的是，這句據說源自中文「好久不見」的洋涇濱英文直翻，後來被英文母語者廣泛接受。

risk.note: 朋友間很自然；正式場合用 It's been a long time / It's great to see you again。

examples.en: Hey, long time no see! How've you been?
Long time no see! You look great.

slang.meaning: 酒水自備（Bring Your Own Bottle / Booze）
slang.usage: 派對邀請或餐廳說明上常看到，意思是主人不提供酒，客人自己帶。唸法是四個字母 B-Y-O-B。

risk.note: 寫在邀請裡很正常。有些餐廳會收 corkage fee（開瓶費）。

examples.en: Party at my place on Saturday. It's BYOB!
examples.zh: 週六在我家開派對，酒水自備！

examples.en: That restaurant is BYOB, so let's pick up some wine on the way.
examples.zh: 那間餐廳可以自帶酒，我們路上去買瓶紅酒吧。

review.question: Sorry, I can't come on Friday. I ___ my parents for dinner.
review.explanation: 複習第 9 單元：已排定的行程用進行式。

review.question: I don't know what time I'll finish, so let's play it by ___.
review.explanation: 複習第 9 單元：play it by ear = 到時候再看。

review.question: I can't come to work. I ___ a fever.
review.explanation: 複習第 8 單元：have a fever。

review.question: There aren't ___ good cafés around here.
review.explanation: 複習第 6 單元：café 可數，用 many。

review.question: We ___ (hang) out at the beach all afternoon.
review.explanation: 複習第 4 單元：hang out → hung out。

review.question: I'm ___ a taxi, be there in five!
review.explanation: 複習第 3 單元：計程車用 in。

review.question: A: Want a bag? B: I'm ___, thanks.
review.explanation: 複習第 2 單元：I'm good = 不用了。

review.question: Your friend says the party is BYOB. What should you do?
